high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account @NotFarLeftAtAll, which has a verified badge and is associated with the handle WeGotitBack. The tweet was posted on November 7th. The tweet reads: "Prince William preparing his speech whilst travelling to COP30 in Belém, Brazil on a Private Jet..." The tweet includes two photographs of a man sitting inside an airplane. The man appears to be writing or reviewing documents while seated in a well-lit cabin. He is dressed formally in a white shirt and a dark tie.
